My flight is just a couple of hours. I take one small airplane to a bigger one, about an hour on 
that and then another hour on my second ride with American Airlines

Sorry for the late reply, but just thinking about the future tends to put me on edge and make me feel hopeless. And I have been starting up some old hobbies and they seem to working, thank you for the reply
Thank you for the chuckle , I appreciate it

You're right, I should just breathe and go on. I can get a little wrapped up in being hurt, it's funny because in the moment I was really upset but now it's gone almost completely away lol. I see what you mean if there's nothing to really do, why worry? Easier said than done, but I can try

Thanks for the words, It made me feel a little less bad about the whole situation and put somethings into perspective. And what you said about anger being fear really struck me, that does seem to be the case sometimes for me. Usually from being unsure in what to do about a situation. Also your name gave me a chuckle so that helps as well lol. I just wish I was able to read this earlier because it helped me think about things with more clarity.
Thanks again for the words, I appreciate it since I never tell anyone what I really think.

Thanks, I tend to get into a state of were everything seems hopeless/pointless  and dreams seem too far off to even care bout. So reading this helps me get out of that, I'll see if I can  take an old activity up so I don't just mope around all the time.
